items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Dieser Bescheid wird rechtskräftig und vollstreckbar, wenn Sie nicht innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach seiner Zustellung Einspruch einlegen.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) and the attached copy of the delivery envelope states the delivery date as 03.05.2027 (a Monday). Because this is formal service, the statutory 3/4-day deemed-delivery fiction for ordinary post does not apply; the actual service date (2027-05-03) is the anchor instead. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service itself is not counted, so counting starts 2027-05-04. Two weeks (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) from 2027-05-03 land on Monday 2027-05-17, but that day is Pfingstmontag, a public holiday in NRW, so under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG / § 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next business day, Tuesday 2027-05-18.

items.title: Pay the fine, fee and delivery costs (total EUR 128.50) after the decision becomes final
items.quote: danach ist er innerhalb von zwei Wochen auf das Konto DE42 4600 0000 0003 0700 00 unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens zu überweisen.
items.computation: Payment is explicitly due only after the Bescheid becomes 'rechtskräftig' (final), i.e. only if no Einspruch is lodged within the two-week period ending 2027-05-18 (see the objection item above). If unchallenged, Rechtskraft occurs the following day, 2027-05-19. The letter then gives a further two weeks to pay, counted the same way (§ 187 Abs. 1, § 188 Abs. 2 BGB): day after Rechtskraft is the start, two weeks later is Wednesday 2027-06-02, which is a normal business day in NRW, so no shift is needed. This date is conditional: if an Einspruch is filed in time, this payment obligation does not arise (or is suspended) and the letter does not state a new date for that case.

warnings: The payment deadline (2027-06-02) only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 2027-05-18; if an Einspruch is lodged, this payment obligation is suspended and the letter gives no new date, so do not pay before Rechtskraft as the letter itself warns ('Bitte zahlen Sie den Betrag nicht vor Rechtskraft dieses Bescheids').

The recipient's address on the letter (73728 Musterlingen am Neckar) carries a Baden-Württemberg postcode, while the holiday calendar used here (Nordrhein-Westfalen) follows the person's given region and the sender's presumed NRW seat (postcode 57390 Musterberg); if the sender's or recipient's actual Land differs, the Pfingstmontag shift of the objection deadline should be rechecked against that Land's holidays.

The IBAN DE42 4600 0000 0003 0700 00 is well-formed and its bank code matches the named Sparkasse Beispielsauerland, but a valid IBAN does not prove the account belongs to the Bußgeldstelle; verify payee details independently before transferring, especially since the payment is not due immediately.

Page 2 of the letter is presented as a scanned copy of the delivery envelope rather than an original enclosure; this is unusual to include with the letter itself and its stated delivery date (03.05.2027) is used here as the Zustellung date, but it could not be independently verified.
